title: Postal Inspectors Warn 1,300+ Alleged Money Mules

lines.say: More than thirteen hundred warning letters. On November thirteenth, postal inspectors mailed them to people they say were money mules for Georgia inmates.
lines.show: More than 1,300 warning letters. On November 13, postal inspectors mailed them to people they say were money mules for Georgia inmates.

lines.say: The letters warn they could face criminal charges if they keep moving the money.

scene.label: Source: U.S. Department of Justice · press conference · Nov 24, 2026

lines.say: Six days later, the F.C.C. approved a rule letting state prisons jam contraband cell phone signals.
lines.show: Six days later, the FCC approved a rule letting state prisons jam contraband cell phone signals.

scene.label: Source: THV11 · FCC approves contraband phone jamming · Nov 2026

lines.say: The department also lists charges in Illinois and Texas, a Georgia state indictment of seventeen people for smuggling phones into prisons, and seized websites.
